## Description
The Large Greenhouse is made of stronger structural and cladding material such as coextruded laminate of polyamide and polyolefin interwoven around an aluminum frame to give rise to a scaffolded retention bladder. It is furnished with a lab with instruments. It has a spacious interior for high volume crop cultivation and has a high resource storage capability.
